verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents Lifecycle Workflows, which are processes that "run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle" (joiner/mover/leaver events). Conditional Access adds if-then policy rules evaluated on access events, such as requiring MFA for Microsoft 365. Both are first-party, rule-driven automations, but they are scoped to identity-governance and sign-in events rather than general event-to-action automation. Missing for 10: documentation of configurable trigger types and custom actions, general-purpose event rules beyond the identity lifecycle and sign-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
